# pr-axis dev

> pr-axis dev is an independent studio working in three services: design, build, and automate. Sites and interfaces are designed, built into working products, and the repeated work around them is automated.

## About

- [pr-axis dev](https://pr-axisdev.com/): The studio site. Describes the three services, how a project runs from inquiry to handover, and starter prices.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pr-axisdev.com/): What the studio offers, the services and starter prices, how a project runs, and the inquiry form.
- [Privacy](https://pr-axisdev.com/privacy): What the inquiry form collects and who processes it.

## Notes

- No client projects have shipped yet, so the site makes no case-study or results claims.
- Pricing shown is "from" pricing for starter work; larger scopes are quoted per project.
